notes.title: ✨Our latest demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

From October 14th to 21st, during the Steam Next Fest, we will be bringing you the latest demo of Shattered Dimension. You'll finally get a glimpse of this mysterious puzzle game!

Since our game is still in development, this demo includes part of the puzzles related to the first three character cards, but the actual gameplay and duration are just a small portion of the full version. Rest assured! Through the demo, you can see our design concepts and main gameplay. If you have any thoughts or suggestions about the game, please let us know!

If you like it, please add the game to your wishlist!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194293/deea59b7c28b095ab39be7db4a61352a7ac46ec9.png

Your feedback and support are our greatest motivations. Thank you for your continued support. We are committed to bringing you the best content and look forward to moving forward together with you.

Cotton Game
